subject: english
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: It is not even a consciuos process.
It is not even a concious process.
It is not even a conscious proccess.
It is not even a conscious process.

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4 i.e.** (It is not even a conscious process.)'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the options**, *'It is not even a conscious process.'* is the sentence that is spelled correctly. 
 
• 'Conscious' refers to being aware of and responding to one's surroundings,(सचेत) and 'process' refers to a series of actions or steps taken to achieve a particular end.(प्रक्रिया)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **'It is not even a conscious process.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 **'It is not even a consciuos process.' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'conscious'.
 
• **Option 2 **'It is not even a concious process.' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'conscious'.
 
• **Option 3 **'It is not even a conscious proccess.' is incorrect. The correct spelling is 'process'.
